11.Day Care Treatment

Day care treatment means medical treatment, and/or surgical procedure which is:

i. undertaken under General or Local Anaesthesia in a hospital/day care centre in less than 24 hrs technological advancement, and

ii. Which would have otherwise required a hospitalization of more than 24 hours. Treatment normally an outpatient basis is not included in the scope of this definition.

12. Deductible

Deductible means a cost sharing requirement under a health insurance policy that provides that the Ins

be liable for a specified amount (in INR) in case of indemnity policies and for a specified number of day

case of hospital cash policies which will apply before any benefits are payable by the Insurer. A deduct

not reduce the Sum Insured.

Deductible will be applicable either per year (Aggregate Deductible) or per claim, as specified in the PC Schedule.
